data.exact_reserve_text: It is disappointing to record a loss for the year, which is driven primarily by reserves strengthening on discontinued business plus reserves for possible claims arising from the COVID-19 pandemic.

named_events.loss_description: the syndicate has recorded a net loss reserve of GBP 7.5m

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims reserves were GBP 39.864m. The syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 11.431m (c. 28.7% of opening gross claims reserves). Management attributes the adverse reserve development primarily to reserve strengthening on discontinued business and additional provisions for possible COVID-19 related claims. The development was identified from the syndicate's gross claims development table and aligns with narrative disclosures about COVID-19 related uncertainty.
raw_causal_phrases: reserves strengthening on discontinued business plus reserves for possible claims arising from the COVID-19 pandemic
there is uncertainty in all loss reserves but, in the case of COVID-19, that uncertainty is extended by the nature of the loss event and the fact that the loss is ongoing
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (11.431m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross) because no explicit gross 'movement in prior years' line was presented. Triangle includes only UW years 2018-2020; calculation excludes the two most recent UW years (2019, 2020) per methodology, so only 2018 contributed to PYD. Lob-level gross reserve movements are not explicitly quantified in the report; COVID-19 reserve numbers provided are net of reinsurance.
